roleTitle: Natural resource and environmental programme manager
summary: Management role that plans and justifies programme budgets, briefs decision-makers, manages land or regulatory programme plans and agreements, tracks instrument and policy change, and protects the programme's capacity to form and keep skilled staff, including how AI tools are governed.
evidenceNotice: Reshaping claims are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). No task has a v2 multi-rater assessment yet, so every task shows 'assessment pending'. Change indicators count active signals only (ADR-0028); all linked signals are at watch, so no change indicator moves. v1 values appear only as prior-evidence pointers.
